messages:
maria: Heads up — espresso machine is getting a bit chonky right before the 3pm spike. I can swing by The Whole Grind at 2:55 to avoid the line. Who's in to split a quick run? :coffee: :handshake:
jon: I'm in, add me for $5. need caffeine.
tess: I can bring oat milk from home, but can someone confirm oat vs almond? Partner is allergic to almonds.
ben: I volunteer cookies as an alibi for the mission. Made a test batch this morning. Might be chocolate chip or disaster, TBD :sweat_smile:
sam: Please label dairy clearly this time. Last time someone left an unmarked jug and chaos ensued. Also, can we avoid hazelnut syrups? Nuisance.
kitchen-bot: Reminder: dishwasher cycle completed at 14:47. Fridge temp: 5.8°C. Coffee beans low: 27% (reorder threshold 25%).
maria: Plan: jon + me + sam chip in $5 each (jon already volunteered), tess brings oat milk (confirmed), ben brings nut-free cookies (ben pls confirm nut-free), I'll pick up 6 double espressos at 2:55 and leave one behind with a sticky note "Redwood — caffeinate responsibly". Order: "6x double espresso, oat milk on 2, no syrup".
tess: Confirmed oat only, no almonds. I'll label the jug "TESS - OAT" and put it top shelf.
ben: Baking update: chocolate chip, nut-free, small bite size. If any dietary emergencies, I can swap to plain sugar ones.
jon: Sent $5 to maria via Venmo @maria — note: "espresso run"
maria: Got it, thanks! :thumbsup: I'll shout when I'm back. If anyone needs decaf, say now.
sam: Decaf for me please, and can you bring a tiny jar of sugar-free syrup for team tester?
maria: Noted. Also will leave a sticky note on the machine: "If it starts coughing, try power cycle + tamp" (full note later).
kitchen-bot: Slack reminder: dispose compostable cups in the green bin. Next compost pickup: tomorrow 08:00.
ben: Cookie accountability: if crumbs appear in keyboards, I accept blame and will deploy napkins.
jon: 2:50 meet at the breakroom?
maria: Perfect — see you all. Kudos to ben for baking bravery.
tess: Yay snacks :cookie:
